caption: The image displays a rectangular composition of fabric swatches arranged in a regular grid pattern, resembling a quilt. The grid is made up of five rows and four columns of rectangular or square swatches. The background color anchoring many of the swatches is a light, cream or off-white hue, with some swatches being almost solid and others displaying fine patterns. The patterned swatches include a variety of floral and botanical designs, with motifs in colors such as pink, red, yellow, green, blue, and black. Some swatches feature intricate small flowers and leaves in delicate lines, while others have larger, bolder flower designs. Several swatches use a dark brown or black as the background, making the floral or plant motifs more prominent, while other patches are mostly off-white with linear or cross-hatch patterns in pale pink or beige. Two swatches display a repeating motif of small, stylized yellow flowers with brown stems. At the bottom right, there are two adjoining swatches with tightly packed small floral patterns in blue, red, and pink shades. The entire composition is set against a plain off-white background, with the swatches bordered by clear, straight lines. There is a small, faint, cursive inscription at the bottom right corner of the background.
title: Patchwork Quilt
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
